label: Transactions analysed
definition: Total rows across the train and test source frames.

label: Observed fraud rate
definition: Fraud transactions divided by all transactions.

label: Graded findings
definition: Entries in the run's findings ledger.

label: Generated artifacts
definition: PNG figures, interactive HTML artifacts and CSV tables in the output bundle.

label: End-to-end run
definition: Wall-clock time between the documented run start and end.

label: Strong findings
definition: Findings assigned grade 'strong' in the source ledger.

label: Test PR-AUC
definition: Average precision on the held-out test split for the final 27-feature LightGBM. This is a cross-boundary OOD estimate.

label: Walk-forward PR-AUC
definition: Mean in-domain validation PR-AUC across four time-ordered folds.

label: OOD transfer gap
definition: Mean fold validation PR-AUC minus the same folds' test PR-AUC.

label: Capture at 1% budget
definition: Share of test fraud events caught when reviewing the top 1% of scored transactions.
